newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill stays neutral on BIG in mid-term.
newsitem.headline: Merrill stays neutral on BIG in mid-term.

text.p: Merrill Lynch in London has maintained its neutral rating for Poland's Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) but said the stock was a good long-term buy because of above-average earnings growth.
"We maintain our intermediate term 'neutral' view, but for longer term we recommend accumulating the shares," Merrill said in a report dated October 16.
Merrill said it had raised its 1996 consolidated net income forecast for BIG to 111 million zlotys from 104 million zlotys and raised its 1997 forecast five percent to 138 million zlotys.
BIG had a consolidated net income of 75 million zlotys last year.
Merrill said BIG should record a 56-million zloty non-consolidated net income this year after recording a net income of 61 million zlotys and 37 million zlotys in 1995 and 1994 respectively.
Merrill said its projections excluded BIG's possible acquisition of a larger stake in Bank Gdanski, though this was an eventual goal of BIG's management.
BIG currently holds 31 percent of Gdanski.
